description: A photo gallery maker: drop pictures in, get a link with its own layout and password. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

captions.description: Captions matched to `fileIds` by position, so the third caption belongs to the third file. Use null or an empty string to leave one uncaptioned. Omit for none.

items.description: The caption for the file at the same position, or null for none.

columns.description: Pictures per row on a wide screen, treated as a maximum: a phone shows at most two across and a tablet three, whatever is set here.

duration.description: How long the public link works, from now: one hour, one day, seven days or thirty days. Cut short if any of the files expires sooner.

fileIds.description: Ids of files the signed-in caller already owns, in the order they should appear. Upload first via POST /v1/files/upload-url then /v1/files/confirm; the gallery stores no bytes of its own. Up to 200 pictures; duplicates are shown once. The link never outlives the files it shows.

items.description: The id of a file in the caller's own storage, as returned on upload.

intro.description: A line of plain text under the heading; never rendered as a link. Omit for none.

layout.description: grid crops every tile to a square for a uniform wall; masonry keeps each picture's own proportions and packs them.

password.description: A password visitors must enter before any picture is fetched. Omit, or send an empty string, for an open link.

title.description: The heading shown at the top of the gallery page, up to 120 characters.

name: photo_gallery
title: Photo Gallery Maker
